name: hook-plate
title: Hook Plate
description: Opening hook of a vertical reel: the speaker's first phrase in upper case, one size for every hook (6% of the frame height), one line within the readable width or two at a whole word, centred on a black rounded plate with equal padding on all sides, under the opening circle (a tall plate rises onto its lower edge); on screen from the first frame. Text, cues and exit are variables; mount over the whole frame.

variables.label: Text
variables.description: The hook: the first phrase of the recording, word for word, never cut. Upper case on screen, one size for every hook (6% of the frame height, 115 px of 1920); one line when it fits 780, else wraps to a second line at a whole word, on the same plate.

variables.label: Cues
variables.description: Comma-separated seconds from mount start: 1 the plate pops in (empty: on screen from 0 s, the thumbnail frame), 2 the plate leaves (only with exit fade).

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: none holds the plate to the end of the mount; fade takes it out at cue 2 (or 0.3 s before the mount ends).
